import XTauPrebirthRails
import R198CausalMiddleCohortPullback

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000

namespace ChompLean

/-!
# Deadline cuts and the youngest diagonal inventory

Work-ID: `X-DEADLINE-CUT-LOWBIT-FORMALIZATION-001`
Run-ID: `XDCLF-20260812-2218-ROOT`

This file splits every diagonal owner of a value `q + k` at the cut `q`.
The old arm is the normalized youngest inventory; the new arm records a
diagonal born after the cut.  The split is disjoint and its witnesses are
unique.  It yields an all-horizon blocker certificate and, below depth three,
the three low-bit formulas without assuming `NoTriple` or any host-cover law.
-/

/-- An old diagonal value still alive `k` clocks above the cut `q`. -/
def YoungDiag (q k : Nat) : Prop :=
  exists a, a < q /\ gameF a a = q + k

/-- A diagonal owner born at or after `q`, but before its target `q + k`. -/
def NewDiagAfterCut (q k : Nat) : Prop :=
  exists i, i < k /\ gameF (q + i) (q + i) = q + k

/-- The normalized lag of the diagonal born at row `a`. -/
noncomputable def gameFDiagonalLag (a : Nat) : Nat :=
  gameF a a - a

/-- Moving the cut one row shifts every old clock down by one and exposes
exactly the diagonal born at the old cut. -/
theorem youngDiag_succ_iff (q k : Nat) :
    YoungDiag (q + 1) k <->
      YoungDiag q (k + 1) \/ gameF q q = (q + 1) + k := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hvalue⟩
    by_cases haq : a = q
    · right
      subst a
      exact hvalue
    · left
      refine ⟨a, by omega, ?_⟩
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hvalue
  · rintro (⟨a, ha, hvalue⟩ | hvalue)
    · refine ⟨a, by omega, ?_⟩
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hvalue
    · exact ⟨q, by omega, hvalue⟩

/-- Exact all-horizon owner partition at a cut.  The diagonal-growth law is
used only to show that an owner at or to the right of `q` occurs strictly
before its target, hence has the form `q + i` with `i < k`. -/
theorem diagonalOwner_cut_partition (q k : Nat) :
    D gameF (q + k) <-> YoungDiag q k \/ NewDiagAfterCut q k := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, hvalue⟩
    by_cases haq : a < q
    · exact Or.inl ⟨a, haq, hvalue⟩
    · right
      have hgt : a < gameF a a := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt a
      rw [hvalue] at hgt
      refine ⟨a - q, by omega, ?_⟩
      have hqa : q + (a - q) = a := by omega
      simpa [hqa] using hvalue
  · rintro (⟨a, _haq, hvalue⟩ | ⟨i, _hik, hvalue⟩)
    · exact ⟨a, hvalue⟩
    · exact ⟨q + i, hvalue⟩

/-- The two sides of the cut cannot own the same diagonal value. -/
theorem youngDiag_disjoint_newDiagAfterCut (q k : Nat) :
    Not (YoungDiag q k /\ NewDiagAfterCut q k) := by
  rintro ⟨⟨a, haq, hold⟩, ⟨i, hik, hnew⟩⟩
  have hai : a = q + i :=
    diagonal_injective gameRecurrenceModel (hold.trans hnew.symm)
  omega

/-- The old-owner witness in `YoungDiag` is unique. -/
theorem youngDiag_witness_unique {q k a b : Nat}
    (_ha : a < q) (hva : gameF a a = q + k)
    (_hb : b < q) (hvb : gameF b b = q + k) :
    a = b := by
  exact diagonal_injective gameRecurrenceModel (hva.trans hvb.symm)

/-- The post-cut birth offset is unique. -/
theorem newDiagAfterCut_witness_unique {q k i j : Nat}
    (_hi : i < k) (hvi : gameF (q + i) (q + i) = q + k)
    (_hj : j < k) (hvj : gameF (q + j) (q + j) = q + k) :
    i = j := by
  have hij : q + i = q + j :=
    diagonal_injective gameRecurrenceModel (hvi.trans hvj.symm)
  omega

/-- The new-owner arm expressed only through future diagonal lags. -/
theorem newDiagAfterCut_iff_lag (q k : Nat) :
    NewDiagAfterCut q k <->
      exists i, i < k /\ gameFDiagonalLag (q + i) = k - i := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hvalue⟩
    refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
    simp only [gameFDiagonalLag, hvalue]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hlag⟩
    refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
    have hgt : q + i < gameF (q + i) (q + i) :=
      gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt (q + i)
    simp only [gameFDiagonalLag] at hlag
    omega

/-- Complete finite-horizon blocker certificate at the cut `q`. -/
theorem blocker_iff_cut_deadline_absent {q k : Nat} (hpositive : 0 < q + k) :
    S gameF (q + k) <->
      Not (YoungDiag q k) /\
        forall i, i < k -> gameF (q + i) (q + i) ≠ q + k := by
  rw [gameF_blocker_iff_no_diagonal_owner hpositive]
  change Not (D gameF (q + k)) <-> _
  rw [diagonalOwner_cut_partition]
  simp only [NewDiagAfterCut, not_or, not_exists, not_and]

/-- Lag form of the complete blocker certificate. -/
theorem blocker_iff_cut_lags_miss {q k : Nat} (hpositive : 0 < q + k) :
    S gameF (q + k) <->
      Not (YoungDiag q k) /\
        forall i, i < k -> gameFDiagonalLag (q + i) ≠ k - i := by
  rw [gameF_blocker_iff_no_diagonal_owner hpositive]
  change Not (D gameF (q + k)) <-> _
  rw [diagonalOwner_cut_partition, newDiagAfterCut_iff_lag]
  simp only [not_or, not_exists, not_and]

/-- Below depth three, no diagonal born after the cut can mature at the
target.  This is the exact role of the unconditional diagonal rail
`d(t) >= t + 3`. -/
theorem no_newDiagAfterCut_of_lt_three {q k : Nat}
    (hq : 3 <= q) (hk : k < 3) :
    Not (NewDiagAfterCut q k) := by
  rintro ⟨i, hi, hvalue⟩
  have hlow : q + i + 3 <= gameF (q + i) (q + i) :=
    gameF_diagonal_lower (by omega)
  rw [hvalue] at hlow
  omega

/-- The all-`k < 3` low-bit formula. -/
theorem blocker_iff_not_youngDiag_of_lt_three {q k : Nat}
    (hq : 3 <= q) (hk : k < 3) :
    S gameF (q + k) <-> Not (YoungDiag q k) := by
  have hpositive : 0 < q + k := by omega
  constructor
  · intro hblocker hyoung
    have hnoOwner :=
      (gameF_blocker_iff_no_diagonal_owner hpositive).mp hblocker
    exact hnoOwner ⟨hyoung.choose, hyoung.choose_spec.2⟩
  · intro hnoYoung
    apply (gameF_blocker_iff_no_diagonal_owner hpositive).mpr
    intro howner
    have hsplit := (diagonalOwner_cut_partition q k).mp howner
    rcases hsplit with hyoung | hnew
    · exact hnoYoung hyoung
    · exact (no_newDiagAfterCut_of_lt_three hq hk) hnew

theorem blocker_q_iff_not_youngDiag_zero {q : Nat} (hq : 3 <= q) :
    S gameF q <-> Not (YoungDiag q 0) := by
  simpa using blocker_iff_not_youngDiag_of_lt_three (q := q) (k := 0) hq (by omega)

theorem blocker_q_add_one_iff_not_youngDiag_one {q : Nat} (hq : 3 <= q) :
    S gameF (q + 1) <-> Not (YoungDiag q 1) := by
  simpa using blocker_iff_not_youngDiag_of_lt_three (q := q) (k := 1) hq (by omega)

theorem blocker_q_add_two_iff_not_youngDiag_two {q : Nat} (hq : 3 <= q) :
    S gameF (q + 2) <-> Not (YoungDiag q 2) := by
  simpa using blocker_iff_not_youngDiag_of_lt_three (q := q) (k := 2) hq (by omega)

/-! ## A diagonal-only certificate for the blocker count -/

private theorem xdclf_nodup_map_of_injective_on
    (f : Nat -> Nat) (xs : List Nat) (hxs : xs.Nodup)
    (hinj : forall x, x ∈ xs -> forall y, y ∈ xs ->
      f x = f y -> x = y) :
    (xs.map f).Nodup := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
      have hnd := List.nodup_cons.mp hxs
      change (f a :: as.map f).Nodup
      rw [List.nodup_cons]
      constructor
      · intro hmem
        rcases List.mem_map.mp hmem with ⟨y, hy, hay⟩
        have hay' : a = y :=
          hinj a (by simp) y (by simp [hy]) hay.symm
        subst y
        exact hnd.1 hy
      · apply ih hnd.2
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        exact hinj x (by simp [hx]) y (by simp [hy]) hxy

/-- The diagonal range in `[1,n]`, computed from the one-dimensional
diagonal prefix with owner indices `< n`. -/
noncomputable def gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList (n : Nat) : List Nat := by
  classical
  exact ((List.range n).map (fun a => gameF a a)).filter
    (fun k => decide (k <= n))

/-- Number of diagonal values in `[1,n]`, exposed as a diagonal-only finite
certificate rather than as a query to the blocker predicate. -/
noncomputable def gameFDiagonalPrefixCount (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList n).length

theorem gameF_mem_diagonalValuesThroughList {n k : Nat} :
    k ∈ gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList n <->
      0 < k /\ k <= n /\ exists a, gameF a a = k := by
  classical
  simp only [gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList, List.mem_filter,
    decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, hvalue⟩, hle⟩
    subst k
    have hgt : a < gameF a a := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt a
    exact ⟨by omega, hle, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨_hpos, hle, ⟨a, hvalue⟩⟩
    have hgt : a < gameF a a := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt a
    refine ⟨⟨a, by omega, hvalue⟩, hle⟩

theorem gameF_diagonalValuesThroughList_nodup (n : Nat) :
    (gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList n).Nodup := by
  classical
  unfold gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList
  apply List.filter_sublist.nodup
  apply xdclf_nodup_map_of_injective_on (fun a => gameF a a)
    (List.range n) List.nodup_range
  intro x _hx y _hy hxy
  exact diagonal_injective gameRecurrenceModel hxy

/-- The diagonal-prefix certificate enumerates exactly the positive
nonblockers through `n`. -/
theorem gameF_mem_diagonalValuesThroughList_iff_nonblocker {n k : Nat} :
    k ∈ gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList n <->
      k ∈ gameFNonblockersThroughList n := by
  constructor
  · intro hk
    rcases gameF_mem_diagonalValuesThroughList.mp hk with
      ⟨hpos, hle, howner⟩
    apply gameF_mem_nonblockersThroughList.mpr
    refine ⟨hpos, hle, ?_⟩
    intro hS
    exact (gameF_blocker_iff_no_diagonal_owner hpos).mp hS howner
  · intro hk
    rcases gameF_mem_nonblockersThroughList.mp hk with
      ⟨hpos, hle, hnotS⟩
    apply gameF_mem_diagonalValuesThroughList.mpr
    exact ⟨hpos, hle, ⟨gameFDiagonalOwner k,
      gameFDiagonalOwner_spec hpos hnotS⟩⟩

private theorem gameF_nonblockersThroughList_nodup_xdclf (n : Nat) :
    (gameFNonblockersThroughList n).Nodup := by
  classical
  unfold gameFNonblockersThroughList
  exact List.filter_sublist.nodup (List.nodup_range' 1)

theorem gameF_diagonalPrefixCount_eq_nonblockers (n : Nat) :
    gameFDiagonalPrefixCount n = (gameFNonblockersThroughList n).length := by
  have hAB : gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList n ⊆
      gameFNonblockersThroughList n := by
    intro k hk
    exact gameF_mem_diagonalValuesThroughList_iff_nonblocker.mp hk
  have hBA : gameFNonblockersThroughList n ⊆
      gameFDiagonalValuesThroughList n := by
    intro k hk
    exact gameF_mem_diagonalValuesThroughList_iff_nonblocker.mpr hk
  have hleAB := nodup_subset_length_le
    (gameF_diagonalValuesThroughList_nodup n) hAB
  have hleBA := nodup_subset_length_le
    (gameF_nonblockersThroughList_nodup_xdclf n) hBA
  unfold gameFDiagonalPrefixCount
  omega

/-- Exact diagonal-only reconstruction of the actual blocker count. -/
theorem gameFBlockerCountThrough_eq_diagPrefixComplement (n : Nat) :
    gameFBlockerCountThrough n = n - gameFDiagonalPrefixCount n := by
  classical
  have hpartition0 := List.length_eq_countP_add_countP
    (fun k : Nat => decide (S gameF k)) (l := List.range' 1 n)
  simp only [List.countP_eq_length_filter] at hpartition0
  have hpartition :
      n = gameFBlockerCountThrough n +
        (gameFNonblockersThroughList n).length := by
    simpa [gameFBlockerCountThrough, gameFBlockersThroughList,
      gameFNonblockersThroughList] using hpartition0
  have hlength := gameF_diagonalPrefixCount_eq_nonblockers n
  omega

/-- R195's blocker midpoint can therefore be verified from the diagonal
prefix alone. -/
theorem actualBlockerMidpoint_eq_diagPrefixCertificate (v : Nat) :
    actualBlockerMidpoint v =
      (v + ((v - 1) - gameFDiagonalPrefixCount (v - 1))) / 2 := by
  unfold actualBlockerMidpoint countMidpoint
  rw [gameFBlockerCountThrough_eq_diagPrefixComplement]

/-! ## Exact window count at an arbitrary deadline cut -/

/-- All owners whose diagonal deadlines land in `[q,q+H)`.  Diagonal
growth implies that every such owner lies below `q+H`, so this is a complete
finite enumeration. -/
noncomputable def gameFDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow
    (q H : Nat) : List Nat := by
  classical
  exact (List.range (q + H)).filter (fun a =>
    decide (q <= gameF a a /\ gameF a a < q + H))

/-- The old side of the cut: owners born strictly before `q`. -/
noncomputable def gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow
    (q H : Nat) : List Nat := by
  classical
  exact (List.range q).filter (fun a =>
    decide (q <= gameF a a /\ gameF a a < q + H))

/-- The new side of the cut: owners born in `[q,q+H)`. -/
noncomputable def gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow
    (q H : Nat) : List Nat := by
  classical
  exact (List.range' q H).filter (fun a =>
    decide (q <= gameF a a /\ gameF a a < q + H))

/-- Exact all-window cardinality split by owner index at the cut. -/
theorem gameF_diagonalOwnerLandingWindow_cut_count (q H : Nat) :
    (gameFDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H).length =
      (gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H).length +
        (gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H).length := by
  classical
  have hrange :
      List.range q ++ List.range' q H = List.range (q + H) := by
    have h := List.range'_append
      (s := 0) (m := q) (n := H) (step := 1)
    simpa only [List.range_eq_range'] using (by simpa using h)
  simp only [gameFDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow,
    gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow,
    gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow]
  rw [← hrange, List.filter_append, List.length_append]

/-- Normalized offsets of the old owner arm. -/
noncomputable def gameFOldDiagonalLandingOffsets (q H : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H).map
    (fun a => gameF a a - q)

/-- Normalized offsets of the new owner arm. -/
noncomputable def gameFNewDiagonalLandingOffsets (q H : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H).map
    (fun a => gameF a a - q)

/-- The old window arm is exactly the truncated youngest inventory. -/
theorem gameF_mem_oldDiagonalLandingOffsets_iff {q H k : Nat} :
    k ∈ gameFOldDiagonalLandingOffsets q H <->
      k < H /\ YoungDiag q k := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hk
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hk with ⟨a, ha, hak⟩
    have haData :
        a < q /\ q <= gameF a a /\ gameF a a < q + H := by
      simpa [gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow] using ha
    refine ⟨by omega, ⟨a, haData.1, ?_⟩⟩
    have hEq : gameF a a - q = k := hak
    omega
  · rintro ⟨hkH, ⟨a, haq, hvalue⟩⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow, haq, hvalue]
      omega
    · rw [hvalue]
      omega

/-- The new window arm is exactly the truncated post-cut birth inventory. -/
theorem gameF_mem_newDiagonalLandingOffsets_iff {q H k : Nat} :
    k ∈ gameFNewDiagonalLandingOffsets q H <->
      k < H /\ NewDiagAfterCut q k := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hk
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hk with ⟨a, ha, hak⟩
    have haData :
        (q <= a /\ a < q + H) /\
          q <= gameF a a /\ gameF a a < q + H := by
      simpa [gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow] using ha
    have hgt : a < gameF a a := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt a
    let i := a - q
    have hai : q + i = a := by
      dsimp [i]
      omega
    have hEq : gameF a a - q = k := hak
    refine ⟨by omega, ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · omega
    · rw [hai]
      omega
  · rintro ⟨hkH, ⟨i, hik, hvalue⟩⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨q + i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow, hvalue]
      omega
    · rw [hvalue]
      omega

/-- Old normalized offsets are duplicate-free: subtraction is injective on
this list because every selected deadline is at least the cut. -/
theorem gameF_oldDiagonalLandingOffsets_nodup (q H : Nat) :
    (gameFOldDiagonalLandingOffsets q H).Nodup := by
  unfold gameFOldDiagonalLandingOffsets
  apply xdclf_nodup_map_of_injective_on
    (fun a => gameF a a - q)
    (gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H)
  · unfold gameFOldDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow
    exact List.filter_sublist.nodup List.nodup_range
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxData : q <= gameF x x := by
      have hx' := (List.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      have hx'' : q <= gameF x x /\ gameF x x < q + H := by
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hx'
      exact hx''.1
    have hyData : q <= gameF y y := by
      have hy' := (List.mem_filter.mp hy).2
      have hy'' : q <= gameF y y /\ gameF y y < q + H := by
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hy'
      exact hy''.1
    have hvalues : gameF x x = gameF y y := by omega
    exact diagonal_injective gameRecurrenceModel hvalues

/-- New normalized offsets are duplicate-free for the same reason. -/
theorem gameF_newDiagonalLandingOffsets_nodup (q H : Nat) :
    (gameFNewDiagonalLandingOffsets q H).Nodup := by
  unfold gameFNewDiagonalLandingOffsets
  apply xdclf_nodup_map_of_injective_on
    (fun a => gameF a a - q)
    (gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow q H)
  · unfold gameFNewDiagonalOwnersLandingInWindow
    exact List.filter_sublist.nodup (List.nodup_range' 1)
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxData : q <= gameF x x := by
      have hx' := (List.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      have hx'' : q <= gameF x x /\ gameF x x < q + H := by
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hx'
      exact hx''.1
    have hyData : q <= gameF y y := by
      have hy' := (List.mem_filter.mp hy).2
      have hy'' : q <= gameF y y /\ gameF y y < q + H := by
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hy'
      exact hy''.1
    have hvalues : gameF x x = gameF y y := by omega
    exact diagonal_injective gameRecurrenceModel hvalues

/-- Complete finite-window provenance certificate: a landing offset below
the horizon is present on exactly one of the old or post-cut arms. -/
theorem gameF_deadlineLandingOffset_cut_iff {q H k : Nat} :
    k ∈ gameFOldDiagonalLandingOffsets q H \/
        k ∈ gameFNewDiagonalLandingOffsets q H <->
      k < H /\ (YoungDiag q k \/ NewDiagAfterCut q k) := by
  rw [gameF_mem_oldDiagonalLandingOffsets_iff,
    gameF_mem_newDiagonalLandingOffsets_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hk, hold⟩ | ⟨hk, hnew⟩)
    · exact ⟨hk, Or.inl hold⟩
    · exact ⟨hk, Or.inr hnew⟩
  · rintro ⟨hk, hold | hnew⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hk, hold⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hk, hnew⟩

/-- The two finite-window offset lists are disjoint, not merely separated
at the owner-index level. -/
theorem gameF_old_new_landingOffsets_disjoint {q H k : Nat}
    (hold : k ∈ gameFOldDiagonalLandingOffsets q H)
    (hnew : k ∈ gameFNewDiagonalLandingOffsets q H) : False := by
  have hold' := (gameF_mem_oldDiagonalLandingOffsets_iff.mp hold).2
  have hnew' := (gameF_mem_newDiagonalLandingOffsets_iff.mp hnew).2
  exact youngDiag_disjoint_newDiagAfterCut q k ⟨hold', hnew'⟩
